meta.author:
約書亞樂團
詞曲：Jenn Johnson, Matt Redman, Jonas Myrin, Brian Johnson, Seth Mosely
中譯詞：褚治軒

lines.a: 我能去哪 除了祢施恩座前
lines.b: Where would I run, but to the throne of mercy

lines.a: 我降服於 祢十架的恩典
lines.b: Where would I kneel, but at cross of grace

lines.a: 何等的愛 祢大能手扶持我
lines.b: How great the love how strong the hand that holds us

lines.a: 榮耀君王 祢的鞭傷能醫治
lines.b: There is a King who bore the scars of healing

lines.a: 神的兒子 彰顯恩典真實
lines.b: There is a Son who came in grace and truth

lines.a: 何等的愛 帶我進入祢恩慈
lines.b: How great the love that carries us to kindness

lines.a: 我願降服 高舉祢名
lines.b: So here I bow to lift You high
In all things for all my life

lines.a: 此時此地 願祢升起
lines.b: God here and now be lifted high

lines.a: 祢得榮耀 就在這裡
lines.b: Right here and now be glorified
God who brought me back to life
